messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 4
parts:
Hi Julia,

It seems that GGIR is trying to read an sleeplog, but you don't have loglocation defined in your function call. It might be that you are trying to reprocess data that was already processed before with a sleeplog and then the configuration file stored the loglocation. I would try to set "loglocation = c()" in your function call and run the script again. Hopefully this works.

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 4
parts:
Hi Julia,

I have just run your script in one of my files and I did not get any error. Maybe you should either remove the config.csv file in your output folder to remove the previous configuration of parameters in previous runs of the code, or define a new outputfolder for a fresh start. The argument nnights is used for sleeplog but it is not problematic to have it in your script, GGIR will only attempt to use sleeplog if the argument loglocation is defined (either in your function call or in your config file).

Also, I cannot see the definition of your arguments mode, f0 and f1 in your script, I defined them as mode = 1:5, f0 = 1, f1 = 0.

Finally, note also that you have overwrite = FALSE in your script, if you are trying to re-process files that were already processed in the past, you should set this to TRUE.

Best,
Jairo
